verdict.rationale: Base44 provides a documented SDK for CRUD operations on app entities, a CLI for creating/deploying/managing backend projects programmatically, and an MCP server that exposes the Base44 account to AI assistants for programmatic app management, plus 'bring your own agent' sandbox access — all clearly enabling AI-native, API-driven app generation and management. Missing for 10: a public OpenAPI/REST spec (probed and returned 404) and independent/hands-on corroboration of the API's robustness beyond vendor docs.
